title: SmartAgri UGM Strengthens Research–Industry Collaboration on Day Two of INAGRITECH 2025
author: Athala Fawwaz
excerpt: SmartAgri UGM continued its strong presence at INAGRITECH 2025 on Day 2 (July 30, JIEXPO Kemayoran), drawing diverse visitors, from academics and industry players to international guests, to its booth showcasing sensor-based monitoring systems, IoT crop cultivation integration, and cloud-based agricultural decision-support software. The day also highlighted a growing cross-sector collaboration, with PT Cendekia Prima Inovasi serving as main sponsor, further strengthening SmartAgri's institutional profile as a professional and adaptive research unit.
body:
**Jakarta**. SmartAgri UGM's participation in INAGRITECH 2025 continued with high enthusiasm on the second day of the event, Wednesday (30/7). Held at JIEXPO Kemayoran, Jakarta, the day brought an interactive atmosphere between the SmartAgri team and a diverse range of attendees, from academics and industry players to international visitors.

At the SmartAgri booth located at A303-01, Hall A3, the team showcased a number of flagship technologies in the field of precision agriculture, including sensor-based environmental monitoring systems, IoT integration for crop cultivation, and cloud-based software supporting efficient agricultural decision-making.

![](/brand/uploads/b2.webp) ![](/brand/uploads/b3.webp)

Throughout the day, lively discussions and Q&A sessions took place between the research team and visitors interested in the university's approach to designing field-need-based technology. This enthusiasm reflects a growing public awareness of the importance of technology adoption in the agricultural sector, particularly in the context of climate change adaptation, resource efficiency, and production sustainability.

A special highlight on the second day was the professional and cohesive appearance of the SmartAgri team, made possible through official uniform support from **PT Cendekia Prima Inovasi**, which also served as the main sponsor. This collaboration strengthens SmartAgri's institutional image as a research unit that is adaptive, professional, and open to cross-sector synergy.

![](/brand/uploads/b4.webp)

Through the connections made throughout the event, SmartAgri continues to expand its collaboration network and open new spaces for partnership in driving digital transformation in Indonesia's agricultural sector, particularly in tropical regions.

SmartAgri expressed gratitude to all parties whose support made this active participation possible, and looks forward to continued synergy in building a resilient and sustainable agricultural ecosystem.
